desc:
Combine "Squid Game Red Light Green Light" with "Be Crushed By A Speeding Wall" Add LAVA 🔥

🔥 Survive lava to get to the other side!
🧗‍♂️ Climb fast, jump across platforms, and avoid falling!
😈 Push other players into the lava and race to the top!
💎 Collect gems to unlock awesome items that help you escape the lava!

Play with friends, unlock cool items, and become the lava survival champion!
